name: Shifting Grift — with only the artifact mode picked, the exchange lists and swaps artifacts, not creatures
notes: Spree: "+ {2} — Exchange control of two target creatures. + {1} — … two target artifacts. + {1} — … two target enchantments." Found by the exchange-control audit unit (2026-11-18). Each mode has its own exchange effect, and the modal, getEffectInfo and getExchangeControlCandidates took the first (creatures) whichever mode was picked, so a pair of artifacts could not be chosen and a pair from the list was refused by the engine. _exchangeControlEffect now takes the one not disabled.
